verdict_note: Strong GTM and positioning expertise with proven cross-functional leadership, but lacks direct product marketing title experience and fintech domain knowledge; visa sponsorship requirement is a material constraint for Stripe.

breakdown.note: 8+ years GTM/growth leadership exceeds 7-year PMM minimum, but titles are Program Manager and AGM, not PMM; no explicit product marketing role on resume, though responsibilities overlap significantly.

Strong match on messaging/positioning, competitive intelligence, cross-functional coordination, sales enablement, data-driven decision-making, and storytelling. Missing: direct SaaS B2B2C experience, technical product launches at enterprise scale, demand generation campaign ownership.

EdTech D2C funnel expertise does not directly transfer to fintech B2B SaaS infrastructure. No payments, billing, tax, or financial products experience. No demonstrated ability to explain complex financial/technical concepts to enterprise buyers.

Proven ability to own go-to-market end-to-end, drive 25%+ growth through positioning redesigns, manage 60+ cross-functional teams, build sales enablement systems. P&L ownership and funnel optimization metrics are directly relevant to Stripe's needs.

Currently on OPT, will require H1B sponsorship. Stripe is a late-stage, well-funded company with sponsorship capacity, but visa requirement is a hiring friction point not explicitly addressed in JD and reduces candidate competitiveness vs. US-authorized peers.

top_signal: Owned end-to-end D2C funnel positioning and GTM execution at 150M+ user scale with 25% sales growth from messaging redesign; demonstrates strategic positioning rigor and cross-functional leadership Stripe values, plus data-driven decision-making capability.
biggest_gap: No direct product marketing title, no fintech/B2B SaaS infrastructure experience, and visa sponsorship requirement will require internal advocacy—candidate's EdTech background, while impressive in scope, does not establish credibility in financial products storytelling or enterprise buyer psychology that Stripe's payment/billing/tax products demand.
